description: Java source file for CubeMapActivity, an Android activity demonstrating the use of OpenGL ES 1.x cube mapping extension, including rendering a textured cube map on a rotating torus with support for extension detection and resource management.

classes.name: CubeMapActivity
classes.description: Main activity demonstrating OpenGL cube mapping, rendering a textured torus with cube maps, managing extension support, and user interaction.

classes.name: Renderer
classes.description: Inner class implementing GLSurfaceView.Renderer interface to handle OpenGL rendering lifecycle: initialization, drawing frames, and handling surface changes.

classes.name: Grid
classes.description: Helper class representing a grid of vertices used to generate the torus mesh with vertex and normal data, managing VBOs for efficient rendering.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the GLSurfaceView and sets the renderer for rendering the cube map demonstration.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Resumes the GLSurfaceView rendering when activity gains focus.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Pauses the GLSurfaceView rendering when activity loses focus.

methods.name: checkGLError
methods.description: Utility method to check for OpenGL errors and throw RuntimeException if present.

methods.name: generateCubeMap
methods.description: Loads six images as textures, creates a cube map texture, and uploads images to each face.

methods.name: generateTorusGrid
methods.description: Generates a grid mesh in the shape of a torus with correct vertex and normal data.

methods.name: checkIfContextSupportsCubeMap
methods.description: Checks if the current GL context supports the GL_OES_texture_cube_map extension.

methods.name: checkIfContextSupportsExtension
methods.description: Checks whether a specific extension is supported in the current GL context.
